title: Grassification Flanders roadside-grass LCA results and scope reference
description: Twenty-one source-located scope, scenario, impact-result, impact-contribution, and data-availability records transcribed from the public 2021 Grassification LCA deliverable. These are comparison results, not characterization factors or GreenHub inventory inputs.
source_title: Life Cycle Assessment of roadside grass verges in Flanders
editor: Rahul Ravi, Ghent University; contributor: Marcella Fernandes De Souza
source_location: PDF pp. 5–10, sections 1.1–2.3; exact page stored per row
license: Public project deliverable; no explicit reuse license identified. Attribution retained; confirm terms before broader redistribution.
applicability: Useful methodological comparator for a roadside-grass baseline versus grass/manure co-digestion, consequential substitution, fertilizer credits, and multiple impact categories. It informs how counterfactuals and credits must be separated from gross emissions.
conversion_and_scaling: Reported numbers and units transcribed without conversion or scaling. Rows distinguish scenario totals from contributions and avoided-burden credits. Functional unit is 1 tonne of mowed grass, cradle-to-farm-gate.
uncertainty: Climate and acidification results are report outputs; human-health figures are medians across 1000 Monte Carlo runs. Full LCI, characterization-method version details, and complete uncertainty distributions are not attached. Co-feed fractions enter burden-free, and displaced biowaste treatment is consequentially modeled.
provenance_note: The deliverable states its complete LCI is available on GitHub on request; no underlying LCI was obtained or reconstructed. Negative results are net avoided-burden scores, not negative physical emissions. No GreenHub LCA factors, credits, or outputs are changed.
